tools.name: analyze_base_token_safety
tools.description: Pre-trade risk gate for a Base (chain 8453) ERC-20. Evaluates mempool front-running, JIT liquidity, and cross-pair cascade risk. Input: token_address only. Returns status SAFE | WARN | DANGER, risk_score 0-100, and a recommendation. When BILLING_MODE=x402, tools/call requires an x402 payment; initialize and tools/list stay free.

token_address.description: ERC-20 contract address on Base mainnet (0x followed by 40 hex characters).
